name: OverTask
summary:
Hello! Are you the new intern?
You're trapped in a chaotic office where every superior tries to dump their work on you. Tasks keep piling up nonstop, the boss interrupts to demand that you deal with their whims, and your stress level rises with every second. You’ll need to move fast, manage the chaos, and find moments to rest while struggling to survive the avalanche of work. Hold out as long as you can... before the stress overwhelms you.
